# Refund policy

## 1. Scope

This policy applies to all orders placed on the online store by consumers in the European Union.

## 2. Withdrawal period

Customers may withdraw from a purchase within 14 days of delivery without giving a reason. The withdrawal period starts the day after the goods are received.

## 3. Refunds

Refunds are issued within 10 business days after we receive the returned goods. The refund uses the original payment method. Return shipping costs are borne by the customer unless the item was defective.

## 4. Exclusions

Personalised items and perishable goods cannot be returned. Digital downloads are excluded once the download has started.
